title: Whisper exercises
description: Resonance exercises done in a whisper, with no voice, read from the formants of the whispered sound. Shown in file order.

id.description: Stable id starting with wh-. Practice history refers to it, so never change or reuse one that has shipped.

cue.description: Short name on the exercise card.

sub.description: A few words under the name on the card.

kind.description: siren: slide the whisper's brightness up and down; done after two full slides. hold: hold the whispered vowel in the goal zone for about two seconds. Each kind has its own check in src/app.js, so a new kind is a code change.

vowel.description: Vowel key from the formant table in src/dsp.js (see control.schema.json for the list). For hold, the vowel the score is measured against; for siren, the vowel the demo starts from.

why.description: One or two sentences on what the exercise is for.

oneOf.description: A step that depends on the training goal.

steps.description: Steps shown in order. Use an object with feminine and masculine for a step that differs by goal.
